2607.12547.title: Mind the Gap: Promises and Pitfalls of Hierarchical Planning in LeWorldModel
2607.12547.paper_summary: We investigate whether temporal hierarchy can improve LeWorldModel on long-horizon goal-conditioned control. We introduce Hi-LeWM, an extension that freezes the pretrained low-level LeWM and adds high-level planning over latent subgoals. We evaluate Hi-LeWM on PushT and Cube across increasing goal offsets. Hierarchy does not automatically improve performance: at short horizons, the best configuration uses a one-step high-level horizon, while longer horizons reveal a mismatch between the learned high-level action space and the inference-time search distribution. Experiments with true future latent subgoals show that the frozen low-level controller can execute well-aligned intermediate targets, indicating that high-level subgoal generation is the main bottleneck. Unconstrained search can select latent macro-actions that appear favorable under the learned model but produce poor control targets. Constraining search around macro-actions encoded from training trajectories, with appropriate subgoal execution timing, recovers useful hierarchical regimes, improving over flat LeWM by +11.3 percentage points at medium-range horizons and +14.7 percentage points at the longest PushT horizon. Overall, temporal abstraction can benefit compact frozen LeWM, but only when high-level search remains compatible with the low-level controller
2607.12547.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究時間層級是否能改善 LeWorldModel 在長期目標條件控制上的表現。<lb/>我們引入 Hi-LeWM，一個擴展，凍結預訓練的低層 LeWM，並在潛在子目標上添加高層規劃。<lb/>我們在 PushT 和 Cube 上評估 Hi-LeWM，並逐漸增加目標偏移量。<lb/>層級結構並不會自動改善性能：在短期內，最佳配置使用一步的高層時間範圍，而較長的時間範圍顯示出學習的高層動作空間與推理時的搜索分佈之間的不匹配。<lb/>對真實未來潛在子目標的實驗表明，凍結的低層控制器可以執行良好對齊的中間目標，這表明高層子目標生成是主要瓶頸。<lb/>不受限制的搜索可以選擇在學習模型下看似有利的潛在宏觀動作，但會產生不良的控制目標。<lb/>在從訓練軌跡編碼的宏觀動作周圍約束搜索，並適當執行子目標的時機，恢復有用的層級體系，在中距離範圍內比平坦的 LeWM 提高了 +11.3 個百分點，在 PushT 最長時間範圍內提高了 +14.7 個百分點。<lb/>總體而言，時間抽象可以使緊湊的凍結 LeWM 受益，但僅當高層搜索與低層控制器保持兼容時。
